semantic_twin_audit.population: all 42 Fano single-literal-flip residuals from X
semantic_twin_audit.corresponding_twin: Fano with the flipped source clause deleted rather than replaced
required_checks: exact 128-assignment model sets equal for each of 42 pairs
deletion twin is SAT and decisively handled by current micro stack
flip twin is SAT and remains RESIDUAL_FIXPOINT

balanced_module.selection_rule: among connected B-family SAT residuals whose exact models contain both x1=false and x1=true, choose lexicographically smallest formula_hash

family_A_SAT_chains.construction: conjunction of k variable-disjoint renamed copies of the balanced residual module
family_A_SAT_chains.known_semantics: SAT by concatenating the lexicographically first exact 7-variable module model across copies
family_A_SAT_chains.predeclared_growth_finding: SAT_CHAIN_DEPTH_GROWTH if any k>=2 requires split depth >=2
family_A_SAT_chains.linear_path_reference: depth=k, nodes=k+1, leaves=1 if every false-first module branch remains SAT and current micro resolves that conditioned copy

family_B_SAT_modules_plus_Fano_UNSAT_tai.construction: k variable-disjoint balanced SAT residual modules followed by one intact variable-disjoint Fano UNSAT tail on the highest-numbered 7 variables
family_B_SAT_modules_plus_Fano_UNSAT_tai.known_semantics: UNSAT from the embedded intact Fano component certified in T/U
family_B_SAT_modules_plus_Fano_UNSAT_tai.predeclared_tree_size_finding: UNSAT_TAIL_TREE_SIZE_GROWTH if node_count strictly increases with k and k=4 has at least 31 nodes
family_B_SAT_modules_plus_Fano_UNSAT_tai.EXACT_FULL_BINARY_PATTERN: reported only if all k=0..4 exactly match the frozen recurrence

component_decomposition_control.interpretation: this would identify a missing solver door, not a SAT lower bound
